'''Yarith Bespin''' was the name of a hotel in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. It housed the [[Pair O'Dice/Legends|Pair O'Dice Casino]].

==Characteristics==
The hotel had a series of [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] running up and down its sides, expansive windows showing the surrounding cityscape and at least one dining hall.

==History==
[[File:Sabaccfinal.jpg|thumb|left|The [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] hosted in Yarith Bespin.]]

It was the most high-class hotel in Cloud City, frequented by dignitaries and celebrities. It is possible that it was also the name of a person for whom the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]] was named for. [[Yarith Figg]] could also be the namesake.

The casino was the location of the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]] final that was contested by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], in which Solo won the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from Lando. <!-- Afterwards, it was also in Yarith Bespin that Lando won the job of [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator of Cloud City]] from [[Dominic Raynor]]. -->

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], having reached Bespin after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Han Solo, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were given a luxurious apartment suite in this hotel by Lando Calrissian, while they waited for the ''Millennium Falcon'' to be repaired.

The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Vaxan]] worked in the casino and when he failed to turn up to work one day, the casino's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dealers became worried about him.<ref name="SGTD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]], ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', ''[[The Queen of Air and Darkness]]'', and ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' the name is spelled as ''The Yerith Bespin''.
